title: Two States of Mind (Video (Standard))
description: In this file I am two voices, one on each side, whispering in your ears and talking to each part of your brain, giving each half of your brain something to listen to in a lovely recursive induction. By virtue of giving your minds multiple points of focus, confusion style inductions help overwhelm your mind until it just shuts down and surrenders to me ... "&nbspThe left side of your brain controls the right side of your body.&nbsp&nbsp&nbsp&nbspThe right side of your brain controls the left side of your body.&nbsp„ Feel yourself surrounded by gentle, irresistible whispers, and just give in.
author: Mistress Shibby
